## Body

After a PM closes your review lane, a colleague's observation about another PR does not assign that review to you. Confirm ownership before starting analysis or delegation; route the observation to the PM or assigned security holder. On the late #241 redirect observation, the PM identified another holder and stopped this seat's check. The delegated check was stopped without assessment or publication. Cancellation is not a pass or a no-findings result. Repeated close-memory turns should verify existing notes, not reopen work or manufacture duplicate lessons.
